about_the_game:
Tabletop Tavern: Command, Conquer, Repeat

Dive into Tabletop Tavern, a real-time strategy roguelike where every battle is a roll of the dice—and every victory is earned. Command your mercenaries on a chaotic tabletop battlefield, recruit a wild roster of warriors, and forge your legacy against relentless goblin hordes. With infinite builds, brutal choices, and endless replayability, this is RTS chaos for roguelike fanatics.

Key Features:

  • Real-Time Tactics: Lead your troops in dynamic, tabletop battles where every move counts.

  • Recruit Your Army: Assemble a diverse band of mercenaries—each with unique skills, quirks, and backstories.

  • Roguelike Mastery: No two runs are the same. Discover powerful gear, craft game-changing builds, and adapt to survive an ever-shifting gauntlet of challenges.

  • Face the Horde: Outsmart and outfight ferocious goblin armies hellbent on your demise.

  • Tough Choices, Epic Rewards: Sacrifice, strategize, and seize glory in a world that punishes the timid.

Will you rise as a legendary commander—or crumble under the weight of the tabletop? Gather your troops and find out.
